n, b = map(int, input().split())
arr1 = list(map(int, input().split()))

pf1 = [0] * n
pf2 = [0] * n
oddCount = 0
evenCount = 0

for i in range(n):
    if arr1[i] % 2 == 0:
        evenCount += 1
    else:
        oddCount += 1
    pf1[i] = evenCount
    pf2[i] = oddCount

diffList = []
prev = 0
for i in range(1, n - 2, 2):
    if prev == 0:
        x = pf1[i]
        y = pf2[i]
    else:
        x = pf1[i] - pf1[prev]
        y = pf2[i] - pf2[prev]
    if x == y:
        diffList.append(abs(arr1[i + 1] - arr1[i]))
        prev = i

p = len(diffList)
arr = diffList
val = [1] * p

dp = [[0] * (b + 1) for _ in range(p + 1)]

for i in range(1, p + 1):
    for w in range(1, b + 1):
        if arr[i - 1] <= w:
            dp[i][w] = max(val[i - 1] + dp[i - 1][w - arr[i - 1]], dp[i - 1][w])
        else:
            dp[i][w] = dp[i - 1][w]

print(dp[p][b])
